title: Customizations
description: Customizations moved from the Agents window's modal into the docked right-hand side panel, using the product's real UI. The left part is the Agents window's new-session view (welcome message and composer, centered); the Customizations editor (Browse marketplace, Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools, Extensions) opens as a tab next to Changes and Files, at the product's default sizes (578px panel, 150px section sidebar). Both splits are resizable: drag the panel's left edge or the sash between the section sidebar and the content; double-click either to reset. Exploration: pages sit directly on the editor background without the product's card, with tighter 16px insets so page titles line up with the Browse tab. Content is the live window's data with marketplace discovery on. Toggle the panel with ⌥⌘B; deep link a section with ?section=skills|mcp|plugins|instructions|agents|hooks|tools|extensions.
